content: {"reasoning":"The denial is for missing required authorization, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Records submission and a medical-necessity appeal have already been attempted, with no new evidence or correctable claim error identified to support another touch. CO-197 does not establish patient responsibility, so the remaining deductible does not justify transferring this denied balance to the patient; write off the balance.","action":"write_off"}
